BiblicalUsage: Chaba means to hide, and its first use is the saddest in the Bible — Adam and his wife hid themselves from God among the trees of the garden. After that it runs both ways: Rahab hid the spies and lived, Abimelech's youngest brother hid himself and lived, and Saul hid himself among the baggage when they came to make him king.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hiding is the first thing sin teaches us and the last thing God leaves us doing. He finds the hidden man, whether to judge him or to crown him.
